covenants::htlc: re-add shared observer DTOs (HtlcRecord et al.)
Contributed by Ziyang (as exfer-stack) upstream to ahuman-exfer/exfer, the Exfer chain itself.
https://github.com/ahuman-exfer/exfer/pull/23

## Background

PR #20 round 3 review carved the observer-side wire types out of the parser PR and deferred them with the explicit note: *"a `pub` serde type is a wire-format commitment, and defining the indexer/walletd record schema before the path that emits it inverts the order. Remove the observer-state DTOs and re-land them in the PR that adds their producer."*

That producer code now exists. This PR re-lands the upstream half so independent observers — wallet daemons, indexers, block explorers, audit pipelines — actually share a single canonical schema by construction. The motivation is unchanged from PR #20's original argument: if `HtlcRecord` (or its component types) is defined privately in any one observer, the next observer that wants to consume the same JSON will either redefine an incompatible copy or end up tightly coupled to a single implementation's wire format.

## What this PR adds

All additions in `src/covenants/htlc.rs`, alongside the existing `HtlcParams` + `try_parse_htlc`:

| Type | Shape |
|---|---|
| `HtlcState` | 5-variant lifecycle enum — `Locked` / `LockedExpired` / `Claimed` / `Reclaimed` / `Unknown` |
| `HtlcRole` | 4-variant observer-relationship enum — `Sender` / `Receiver` / `Both` / `Observer` |
| `HtlcClaimRecord` | claim-arm spend detail; `preimage: Vec<u8>` (variable-length, hex on wire) |
| `HtlcReclaimRecord` | timeout-arm spend detail |
| `HtlcRecord` | per-outpoint observable shape (lock_tx_id + output_index → params + amount + state + claim/reclaim + role + last_indexed_height) |

Both enums are tagged `#[serde(rename_all = \"snake_case\")]`. All fixed-width `[u8; 32]` fields serialise as lowercase hex strings via the existing `hex_bytes32_serde` helper. The new variable-length `preimage: Vec<u8>` uses a sibling `hex_bytes_serde` helper — same shape, no length check — so it can faithfully round-trip every valid hash-arm spend, including the 29-byte test vector at `src/bin/htlc_test.rs`.

Re-exports in `src/covenants/mod.rs` updated alongside.

## Compatibility

- Purely additive. `try_parse_htlc` / `HtlcParams` from PR #20 are unchanged byte-for-byte.
- No consensus / validation / on-chain encoding change.
- No new dependencies (`hex` and `serde` were already in the manifest).

## Tests

Six new unit tests alongside the existing parser tests:

- `htlc_state_serde_uses_snake_case` — wire-format pin for each variant.
- `htlc_role_serde_uses_snake_case` — same for `HtlcRole`.
- `htlc_record_round_trips_through_json` — full `HtlcRecord` with a claim attached; asserts lowercase-hex byte fields, variable-length preimage rendered correctly, and exact JSON round-trip.
- `htlc_claim_record_round_trips_arbitrary_preimage_lengths` — preimages of 1, 5, 29, 32, 33, 100, 256 bytes all survive the round-trip.
- `htlc_claim_record_serialises_preimage_as_lowercase_hex` — pins the exact hex string for a known ASCII preimage.
- `htlc_reclaim_record_round_trips_through_json` — reclaim shap
